notes:
The ESP overlay is back in the release.

- BlackPandaOverlay.exe now ships with the installer and the portable zip. 1.1.9 and 1.1.10 left it out, so the ESP switch turned on with no window to draw.
- The Visuals card reports what the core sees: overlay running, stopped, or missing.
- If the overlay process exits, the core relaunches it while ESP is enabled.
- Packaging refuses to build an archive without the overlay, the core or the lua bundle.
